name: review-desk
description: A review desk panel (/reviews): Claude publishes open questions, decisions, findings, write plans, animated explainers and read-throughs; you answer, ask and submit in the panel, and the outcome goes back to Claude.

folder.title: Reviews folder
folder.description: Folder in the project, relative to its root, that holds pending/ and reviewed/

autoOpen.title: Open the desk when Claude publishes a review
autoOpen.description: Opens the panel on the new review, unless you are in the middle of another one

handOff.title: Hand submitted reviews to Claude
handOff.description: On submit, queue a prompt asking Claude to apply the outcome (it still asks before writing)

selectableText.title: Selectable text
selectableText.description: On the desktop, draw card text so it can be selected and copied (links then show their address instead of opening)
